(ja)༄༅/ /phyag na rdo rje gtum po khyung lnga'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa'i lag len rab tu gsal ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dang dpal

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// phyag na rdo rje gtum po khyung lnga'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa'i lag len rab tu gsal ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dang dpal phyag na rdo rje gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i rjes gnang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis 'di bsgom par 'dod pas skyabs yul gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang nyams pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs= dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes skyabs 'gro ci nus byas pa'i mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas dkon mchog gi byin rlabs rang gzhan gyi rgyud la zhugs par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis dpal rdo rje gtum por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dpal gtum po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes sogs chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs gsum/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs padma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

rang gi sems hūm̐ mthing nag las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi gdon bgegs tshar bcad/ slar 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po dpal phyag na rdo rje gtum po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar stabs su 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dngul gyi dril bu dkur brten pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i snying ga nas mnan pa/ g.yon brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i dpral ba mnan pa/ klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan cing stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs dang*/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ las de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi khyung dkar po g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ mgrin par hrīḥlas padma rigs kyi khyung dmar po g.yas padma 'dzin pa/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje'i rigs kyi khyung mthing nag g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lte bar trām̐ las rin chen rigs kyi khyung ser po g.yas rin po che 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su āḥlas las kyi rigs kyi khyung ljang gu g.yas ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa thams cad rang rang gi sku mdog dang mthun pa'i sbrul zhal du gsol ba/ khyung rnams kyang mchu sder rab tu rno ba/ sgro gshog rnams las me 'bar ba/ zhal nas hūm̐ phaṭa dang krum krum gyi sgra sgrogs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lcang lo can nas dpal gtum po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim par gyur/ oṃ tsaṇḍa sogs yi ge bcu pa gang mang bzlas pa'i rjes su/ ga ru ḍa sogs sbrel ba'ang ci nus bzla/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ shabda'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas// gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi bdag po ste// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i// bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bsdu na shlo ka gcig gis chog spro na/ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni// sku mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer can// gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni// gsung mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis// ngag gi nyes pa'i tshogs 'joms pa'i// rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni// thugs mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis// yid kyi nyes pa'i tshogs 'joms pa'i// rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/

bstod pa 'di ni slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad par snang*/ mchan/ /zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /phyag na rdo rje 'grub gyur nas// sogs dang*/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams// gdul dka' 'dul phyir dpa' bo ni// shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis// ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog /bsod nams 'di yis sogs bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab/ rang nyid gnas skabs thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bsam mo// thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul na/ zlum gtor dang mchod pa bsham/ dmigs rten yod na gong ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ de tsam ma nus na lcang lo can nas spyan drangs nas rten la thim par bsam pa'am/ rten med kyang gong ltar rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya/ de la gtor ma 'og nas 'byung ba ltar phul/ gtor ma gzhan yod pa'am/ med kyang 'das gtor gyi lhag ma phyogs skyong gzhi bdag sogs la phul na'ang legs/ bsnyen pa byed na thun bzhi'i rim pas/ oṃ tsaṇḍa sogs yi ge bcu pa 'bum phrag bcu kha skong dang bcas pa dang*/ ga ru ḍa sogs sham bu btags pa'ang ci mang bzla/ de'i tshe snga thun dgongs thun gang rigs kyi mjug tu gtor ma phul/ byung na thams cad du ngag bcad bya/ tha na'ang thun gyi ring la ngag ma shor ba dang*/ sems ma yengs pa gal che/ tshe 'di'i snyan grags la re ba med pa dang*/ gdon bgegs sogs ma rungs pa rnams la byams snying rje drag po bsgom/ dus thams cad du chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gdod ma nas spros pa dang bral bar shes pa'i lta bas zin par bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang byed na stegs ji ltar rigs par gzhi bzang po'i steng du padma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su mañdzi'i khar gtor ma dmar po zur gsum pa thebs kyus bskor ba bzhag

de'i mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ 'bul gtor gyi zlum gtor gcig dang bcas pa bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril me tog slob ma la dgos pa'i maṇḍal me tog rnams sta gon bya/ mchod pa rnams la dmigs nas/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs rol mo dang bcas lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te gdan bsdu ba'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin nyams su blang ba ni bdag bskyed do// de nas mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i zhes sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan zhes bya ba'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin las rang nyid ces pa dor/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang sngags dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs te/ mtshan sngags re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog sogs kyis bstod/ zlum gtor la chab bran/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis phyag rgya dang bcas pas mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum mam lngas phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod kyi mthar/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/

mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya/ slob ma khrus dang phyag byas nas gral la 'khod par/ me tog bkye bsdu tshar rjes sems bskyed gsal btab/ 'dir gsan rgyu'i chos ni ston pa ni thugs bskyed smon lam mthar phyin nas gang 'dul gyi skur ston te/ sna tshogs gzugs nor lta bu yi// zhes gsungs pa ltar dang*/ gdul bya sems can ni/ bzang spyod las/ nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam par// sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can rnams las dang nyon mongs pas 'phangs te/ lus rten sna tshogs blangs pa la nad dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'byung bas de dag la phan gdags pa'i slad du sku'i rnam pa sna tshogs bstan pa las 'dir steng gdon gza' dang*/ 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gdug pa sel ba'i skor yin/ de'ang nyon mongs pa dug lngas kun nas bslangs pa'i las bsags pa'i 'bras bu smin khar phyi rol gyi rkyen dug lnga'i rang gzugs klu rigs lnga 'khor bcas kyis gnod pa byas pas sad de lus la shu ba sogs kyi nad sna tshogs 'byung ba la de sil bar byed pa ni zhi khro gnyen po skor gsum sprul te/ zhi ba spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra sogs/ khro bo rta mgrin dmar nag phyag na rdo rje sogs dang*/ des kyang mi thul ba la khyung dmar nag khra gsum sogs gsungs pa las/ 'dir dpal phyag na rdo rje la che ba bzhi'am drug gi nang nas 'dir gtum po khyung gis che ba yin/ 'di nyid la'ang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du yod pa las/ da lan dpa' rkyang gi rjes su gnang ba la slob dpon gyis bya bar 'os pa thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar slob dpon la dpal phyag na rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig mdzad par zhu/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// khyod zhabs padmo spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan na skyabs ma mchis// 'gro ba'i dpa' bo mthu chen gyis// blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod// ces gsol ba btab nas/

rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par mos/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog ces rgyud dag par bya ba rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma dpal phyag na rdo rje tha mi dad par mos pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa/ slob dpon gyis oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du 'gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes sogs nas thugs kar hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin gnas lnga'i khyung dang bcas pa bskyed/ yang na slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi gnas gsum byin rlabs 'dir byas kyang rung*/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed tha mi dad pa'i dpral ba'i oṃ las phyag na rdo rje'i sku dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag phyag na rdo rje'i sku dang khyed rang rnams kyi lus dbyer med du gyur par mos pa mdzod/ yang mdun bskyed kyi mgrin pa'i āḥlas phyag na rdo rje'i sku dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag

phyag na rdo rje'i gsung dang khyed rang rnams kyi ngag dbyer med du gyur par mos pa mdzod/ yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las phyag na rdo rje'i sku dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag phyag na rdo rje'i thugs dang khyed rang rnams kyi yid dbyer med du gyur par mos pa mdzod/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi gnas gsum gyi 'bru gsum las phyag na rdo rje'i sku dpag tu med pa dus gcig car du byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du dus gcig car du thim pas/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag phyag na rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur par mos pa mdzod/ ces pas so so'i mjug gam/ thams cad kyi mjug tu sngags dang spos rol bya/ bzlas lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa byas te me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ tsaṇḍa sogs sham bu dang bcas pa sgrub thabs bzhin/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par mos pa byas te/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis sogs nas/ bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang*/ me tog phreng ba sngags su byas nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs kyi mthar/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la dpal phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig

ces brjod/ slob dpon gyis gtor ma bzung*/ gtor ma 'di nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje dngos yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag spro na/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku phyag na rdo rje/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug sprul sku shākya 'bum/ sprul sku shākya seng ge rin chen byang chub rdo rje/ chos rje rtag pa ba/ zur dben pa chos bzang bla ma/ mnyam med bde legs rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ mkhas mchog lha dbang blo gros/ rje btsun sangs rgyas seng ge byams pa ting 'dzin rnam rgyal/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ 'jam mgon lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas 'di man zhal skong*/ mchan/ grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ byams pa nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros/ rje rin chen rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' bkra shis/ byams pa smon lam grags pa/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la sogs rtsa bsdu na 'di man gyis chog mchan/ brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ mdor na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// gtor ma'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ tsaṇḍa sogs brjod/ gtor ma phyag rdor du gsal ba de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas khas blangs pa'i dam tshig sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

gtso bos/ gtang rag maṇḍal/ lus longs spyod thams cad 'bul na cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas sogs spyi dang mthun/ slob ma rang gnas su btang ngo*// mdun bskyed la mchod bstod byas la/ dngos grub blang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing*/ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs dang*/ badzra muḥ gtor ma'i ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus la gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni rang gi brjed thor shākya'i dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bkra shis dbang phyug go/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
